summary: Extremely OK Games' precision-platformer series, including the original PICO-8 game, the 2018 full release, and official anniversary spin-offs.

entries.title: Celeste Classic

primary.why: The official itch.io page presents the original four-day PICO-8 game as a playable HTML5 release.
primary.how_to_play: Play the official browser version on itch.io with keyboard controls.

all_releases.reason: primary: official, accessible route for the original prototype.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The official browser release is the complete public route for this prototype-scale entry.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2018 Celeste is a full reimagining rather than a straight replacement; keep this classic entry distinct.
